<!-- pr-reviewer: 486b03c91c8b1330f1e79ec47500ad68625fdd5a -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One test fails when the PR is merged with current main.

**What looks good**
- The holes and thread pages keep the same controls, labels, tooltips and enabled rules. The new `button`, `small_button`, `list_row` and `radio_pair` wrappers only call the same egui controls.
- Each radio pair keeps its order. The "Remove N" and "Detect holes" buttons set the same state and flags as before. The commands and their values are unchanged.
- `int_range_row` now names the drag value by its row label. This adds an accessible name and changes no value.
- Layering ui -> app holds. No new dependency. No snapshot PNG under `crates/ui/tests/snapshots` changes. All touched files are below 400 lines. The decision file is present.

**Results merged with main (locally, not on the runner)**
- Trial merge with origin/main: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` from `crates/ui`: 790 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

```
family 'tools and machine' has 204 raw ui calls (limit 202): tool_list_page.rs=18, ... machine_editor.rs=39 ...
failed: egui_app::layout::form_seam_tests::pages_do_not_add_raw_egui_calls_outside_the_form_seam
```

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form_seam_tests.rs:140` (`max_raw: 202` for "tools and machine"). Main now has 204 raw calls in that family (see #1639, #1747, #1748, #1776 and the machine editor fix 506beda02). The test fails after the merge. Please merge main, update the limits, and run `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib form_seam`. Note: this count test will fail again each time any other PR adds a raw call to a listed page. Consider a guard for the holes family only, or limits with some room.
2. `docs/reviews/1724/` holds six PNG files and a script. These are review evidence, not product files. Please move them to the PR description, or confirm that the repo keeps them.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The structural tests still cover the holes page by label. No holes-page structural assertion changed.
- Not exercised: the GUI, the before/after screenshots, and the pixel snapshots (release lane).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9df66d0ddfd553a8e929d5ada4b5eb61420fb260 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One test fails when the PR is merged with current main. The earlier item 1 is not fixed in a lasting way.

**What looks good**
- The refactor changes no behaviour. The holes and thread pages keep the same labels, order and click handling. The wrappers in `layout/controls.rs` call the same egui controls. No command or value changes.
- `int_range_row` adds an accessible name to the spring-pass drag value. It changes no value.
- No snapshot PNG under `crates/ui/tests/snapshots` changes. No new dependency. The decision file is present. Layering ui -> app holds.
- Mutation check: I added one `ui.label("x")` to `holes_page.rs`. The pin then reports `family 'holes' has 1 raw ui calls (limit 0): holes_page.rs=1`. The pin works.

**Results merged with main (locally, not on the runner)**
- Trial merge with origin/main: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib form_seam` from `crates/ui`: 1 passed, 1 failed.
- I did not run the full ui suite or clippy again at this head.

```
family 'multi-axis' has 18 raw ui calls (limit 16): wire_page.rs=13, sinker_page.rs=5
failed: egui_app::layout::form_seam_tests::pages_do_not_add_raw_egui_calls_outside_the_form_seam
```

**Earlier review items**
1. Not fixed. The "tools and machine" limit is now 204 and matches main. But main now has new wire-page code (`wire_page.rs`), and the "multi-axis" family is over its limit (`form_seam_tests.rs`, `max_raw: 16`; main gives 18). The test fails after the merge for a second time.
2. Accepted. `docs/reviews/1724/` has a precedent on main (`docs/reviews/1756/`). It does not block the merge.

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form_seam_tests.rs`, family "multi-axis": merge main and set `max_raw` to 18, or better, change the guard. The count limits of the other families fail each time another PR adds a raw call. Keep the hard limit 0 only for the "holes" family. Remove or relax the limits of the families this PR does not migrate. Then run `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib form_seam`.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Not exercised: the GUI, the before and after screenshots, the pixel snapshots (release lane), clippy and the full ui suite at this head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
